filter_polygons_by_area: filter a list of polygons by minimum and maximum area thresholds using cv2.contourArea
approximate_polygon: approximate a polygon by reducing points with Ramer-Douglas-Peucker algorithm while preserving shape
test_filter_polygons_by_area: test filter_polygons_by_area with polygons of varying areas and min/max area constraints
test_approximate_polygon: test approximate_polygon with different percentage values and epsilon_step parameters
refactor_approximate_polygon: refactor approximate_polygon to support configurable minimum point count instead of hardcoded 3
